Butterchurn 2.6.7 (https://github.com/jberg/butterchurn), MIT, by Jordan Berg:
`lib/butterchurn.min.js` and `lib/isSupported.min.js` from the npm package,
unmodified.

`butterchurnPresets-2.4.7.min.js` is `lib/butterchurnPresets.min.js` from
`butterchurn-presets@2.4.7` (MIT, LICENSE-presets): MilkDrop presets converted
for Butterchurn. The presets were written by many MilkDrop authors; each
preset's name carries its authors.

An upgrade goes in a new version folder (/vendor is cached immutable).
